sourceNote: The T-pose panda mesh panda-tpose.glb (armSource, assets/models/panda/README.md), with new quad faces on each arm from the shoulder line to the wrist (panda-arms.glb), so that the arms and the wrists do not twist. tools/blender/arm_rebuild.py makes these faces with the arms 1.05 times longer (--factor 1.05). tools/blender/panda_edge.py then cuts the faces along the edges of the eye patches and along the lower edge of the band, with no change of the form. The other faces and panda-tpose.glb stay unchanged.
weightSourceNote: The weights come from the mesh before the cut of panda_edge.py, and each vertex takes the weights of its place on it (placed_weights() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py). With the weight rules on the cut mesh, the bone heat and the sliver rules changed the weights near the new faces.
paintedNote: The weights of the clavicles and the arms are the automatic weights of Blender with the Weight Paint fixes of tools/blender/arm_rebuild.py. The vertices on the bones of paintedLower keep the rule weights, because the seated bind of the app depends on them.

armSegments.note: Each upper arm and each forearm has 4 deform segments, and each elbow and wrist a helper bone of this length in units: twice the gap of the joint rings of tools/blender/arm_rebuild.py (step_skeleton() prints it). The app turns the bones from the joints of the pose (poseArm() of src/models/studio-rig.ts).

armSourceNote: The arms of the T-pose mesh stand out level and free of the trunk, so tools/blender/arm_rebuild.py rebuilds them with no copy before it.
name: Panda

app.note: The scale puts the standing skull top (with no ear, y 0.978 u) at 1.570 m, the head top of the red fox, as for the panda of the older mesh: 1.6052 m for each unit, with the standing shoulder joints at 1.026202 m (the entry of the panda in ANIMALS): 0.9792 m with the legs of the mesh, and the rise of the longer legs. The reach is the reach of the arm factor, from the shoulder joint to the middle of the palm.

armFactorNote: The factor 1 keeps the arm length, because the rig with arm segments does not stretch the arms. The arms of panda-arms.glb are 1.05 times longer than the source arms (arm_rebuild.py --factor 1.05), and the arm joints are the joints of the longer arms. 1.05 is the smallest factor of the sweep 1, 1.05, 1.08, 1.12, and 1.16 at which the right arm reaches 0.095 m of the trombone slide, as the panda of the older mesh (pnpm hold-reach panda --instrument trombone): 0.065, 0.095, 0.110, 0.135, and 0.160 m. The reach from the shoulder joint to the middle of the palm is then 0.554 m (0.578 m before).
legFactorNote: The thigh is 1.1 times and the shin 1.38 times as long as on the mesh, and the feet keep their size, so that the panda sits on the chair of the panda of the A-pose mesh: the seat top is 0.277 m high (0.278 m on the old panda, 0.181 m with the legs of the mesh), and the thigh and the shin are 0.115 m and 0.133 m long (old 0.114 m and 0.117 m). The shin grows more than the thigh, because the shin stands vertical and lifts the seat by its full length, and the sloped thigh lifts it by less than half of its length. The body rises 0.029 u, so the standing shoulder joints of ANIMALS rise with it and the trunk, the head, and the arms keep their meters.
headFactorNote: The head and the ears are 0.93 times as large as on the mesh, around the neck joint, so that the head is as wide for its height H as the head of the panda of the A-pose mesh (1.128 H, old 1.128 H, 1.212 H with the factor 1) and the pea eyes are as far apart (0.407 H, old 0.406 H). The export keeps the head before the factor for the holds (ungrown() of tools/studio-body.ts). The nose and the mouthpiece move 3 cm back with the smaller head, so the trombone hold of the panda (PANDA_TROMBONE of src/pose/winds.ts) puts the right elbow further out and the rest place further forward.
girthProfileNote: The rows (share of the trunk axis of the source from the hips joint to the neck joint, width, front, back) give the upper chest and the back the taper of the panda of the A-pose mesh (7cf41074), on cuts of the seated bind from the seat to the neck joint (pnpm body-shape trombonist): the width at 0.55 of the cut span is 60.5 cm (old 56.2 cm, 63.5 cm with the width 1), at 0.65 55.0 cm (old 52.2 cm, 59.9 cm), and at 0.75 55.4 cm (old 47.7 cm, 61.7 cm). At 0.75, the widest points of the cut are the undersides of the arm roots, so the row at 0.73 is the narrowest. The shoulder joints are 49.8 cm apart (old 47.9 cm, 51.4 cm with the width 1). With the width 0.93 at the shoulder joint (0.875) and 0.85 at 0.73, the shoulder joints were 47.7 cm apart, and the left paw went 0.5 cm into the trombone at rest (0.2 cm with the width 1). The depth, the belly, the haunch, and the back on the chair keep their places.
armGirthNote: The upper arm takes the factor 0.92 across its axis before the skin (arm_girth() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py), so that the girth at the middle of the seated bind is 67.6 cm (old panda 65.5 cm, 72.8 cm with the factor 1). The forearm keeps its form (56.9 cm, old 58.5 cm). The arms keep their joints and their rings. With the factor, the upper arms go 0.2 cm less into the body at rest and in the lift (pnpm pose-depth trombonist --demo beethoven-5-4).
jointsNote: The places are in the studio units and axes of the source pose: 1 unit from the soles to the top of the ears, the soles at y = 0, +z forward, +x the left side. The right side mirrors the left side. The arms are level in the T-pose, and the arm joints lie on the middle line of the arm at the joints of the 1.05 times longer arms: the wrist where the paw starts to widen, and the elbow a little nearer to the wrist than to the shoulder. The palm is the true palm of the source: the claws of each paw curl down. tools/blender/sections.py measures the cuts. The tail is one bone through the tail ball.

studio.trunkNote: The trunk turns back by the share of each trunk bone until the hip angle opens by open degrees, with the shares of the cat and the dog.
studio.bindArmsNote: With straightArms, bindArms.upper_arm sets the bind upper arm, and bindArms.forearm sets only the elbow axis: the cross product of the bind upper arm and this forearm direction (StudioBody.hinges, bind_hinges() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py). The two directions are the directions of the old bent bind, so the elbow axes and the zero of the roll of the upper arm stay.
studio.straightArmsNote: The bind keeps the arms of the source straight: the forearm and the paw keep the turn of the upper arm, so that the rest shape holds the bend of no role (the role-neutral bind of design 4.4).
studio.bindSupinationNote: The bind paw of each arm turns about its bind forearm toward supination, the left 97 degrees and the right 50 degrees (paw_supination() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py), and the forearm segments share the turn. Each value makes the largest paw twist p95 of the six roles of the cast matrix and the trombone smallest (design 4.4): about 140 degrees on the left (the flute and the snare drum) and 94 degrees on the right (the snare drum and the trombone). Three probes of pnpm bind-supination gave 101 and 50 on the straight rig, then 97 and 50, then no change.
studio.note: The posture of design 5.2: the thigh slopes 25 degrees down and 5 degrees out, and the shin is vertical (tools/rig/leg_turns.py <config> 25 5 0). So the feet stand near each other as on the panda of the A-pose mesh: the ankle gap is 23.7 cm (old 20.4 cm, 24.9 cm with 8 degrees out), and the knee gap 15.0 cm (old 15.7 cm, 15.6 cm with 8 degrees). A shin turned 3 degrees in gave the ankle gap 23.5 cm, and the left side folded 7 faces in the play (5 with the thighs 5 degrees out, pnpm fold-probe trombonist). The foot and the toes keep the turn of the source, so that the soles stand flat on the floor. The tail has one bone, so it needs no bind direction.

sliver.note: The corners of each thin face share one set of weights, so that the face moves rigidly and does not turn over at a bent joint. The values of the fox.

line.note: The middle corner of each long thin face takes the mix of the weights of its two other corners by its place along their line. The values of the fox.

haunch.note: The part of the thigh weight that goes to the hips grows from 0 at the lower height to 1 at the upper height, so that the buttocks stay on the hips. This is the rule of the cat and the dog, moved with the joints of the panda.

weights.note: Above headFrom (the chin), each vertex follows the head only. earBase lies above the head, so the ears follow the head. The vertices in the tail ball follow the tail bone only.
weights.rigidPaintedNote: The corners of each group of faces at these points take the mean of their painted weights (rigid_faces() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py, after the painted weights). The points are the middles of the thin bridge faces at the front of each arm root, in three groups on the left and one on the right, and of one face of the upper chest under the chin. The left shoulder turns forward in the play, and the right arm hangs down to the upright trombone at rest, and these faces folded in each sample of those poses (pnpm fold-probe trombonist --faces). The second group also holds the faces under the left arm root. The T-pose left arm hangs in the rest and the lift of the shared holds, and these faces folded in each such sample of the recast roles (pnpm fold-probe <role>@panda --faces). In one group with the front faces, they move as one part, and the fold does not move to the edge between two groups. A group under the right arm root folded more faces on the right side of the trombonist.
weights.fingersNote: The fingers keep this share of their bone heat weight, and the hand takes the rest, so that the curl of the fingers does not turn over the faces of the palm side of the paw. With the share 1, three faces of each paw folded in each sample, and the arm gate failed on the folds.

flip.note: The long edge of a face of the arms with a corner angle above angle (degrees) flips to the corner of the face on its other side, when the two faces lie almost on one plane and the surface moves at most move (units). The values of the fox.

refine.ringsNote: No ring: the quad tube of each arm of panda-arms.glb has 3 rings at each elbow and at each wrist.

check.note: pnpm rig-mesh --check lists the thin faces of the seated bind mesh near a joint of the arms or the legs. The values of the fox.

tone.note: The white fur takes the full step to the white of SPECIES_COLORS.panda. A row is [L, dL, da, db] in Oklab: a face below the lightness 0.5 does not move, and a face above 0.8 takes the move of the second row. Thus the black parts keep their colors.

colors.note: The eyes and the eye patches have almost the same dark color, so the eye box holds only the brown iris and the black pupil in the patch. A face in the nose box whose color is nearer to the nose color than to white takes the gloss. The rig has no border rule: with it, the black band of the back showed white teeth. The faces of the source are cut along the edge of each eye patch (panda-edge.glb), so each patch keeps the round oval of the texture with no patch rule. The cut puts each face on one side of the edge, but the texture has a soft gray step at the edge, so a face of the edge took the mean of white and gray samples and showed as a gray wedge. With split, such a face takes the mean of its larger half.

eyeShell.note: The values of lift, points, and reach are the values of the fox. darkReach is 0, so that no dark face of the patch around the old eye takes the color of its own ring.

chair.note: The seat is level, and its top is the lowest point of the seated body over the seat, with no shin, foot, or tail. The front edge at -0.085 puts the seat under the haunch, as on the panda of the A-pose mesh (-0.1), so that the chair is 0.210 m deep (old 0.212 m). With -0.03, the sloped thighs set the seat top 12 cm below the hips joint, and the chair was 0.298 m deep. The sit then lifts the lowest haunch up to 11 cm onto the seat top. The back edge holds the back of the haunch.

crease.note: The seated bind is smoothed across the crease where the belly meets the top of each thigh, with the values of the cat and the dog.

sit.note: The underside of the haunch goes down onto the seat in the seated bind (sit() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py), with the values of the cat, except most. most keeps the drop small, so that the round haunch keeps its form.

legFactorNote: The factor 1 keeps the legs of the mesh, with no stretch. The seat of the legs at the front edge of the chair is then 0.181 m high at this scale (0.278 m with the longer legs of the older mesh).

raise.note: The inner faces of the right elbow fold at rest, where the elbow bends more than in the play. The shape relaxes them (pnpm raise-fit trombonist --faces 461,464,459,494 --side R --sets rest,lift). They fold in 28 of 128 samples of the rest and the lift, at a mean turn of the upper arm of 50 degrees from the bind.
